correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import scipy.ndimage as ndi, numpy as np
A=np.array(grid)
def comps(conn=1):
 st=ndi.generate_binary_structure(2,conn)
 arr=[]
 for col in set(A.flat)-{4}:
  lab,n=ndi.label(A==col,structure=st)
  for k in range(1,n+1):
   pts=np.argwhere(lab==k); r0,c0=pts.min(0); r1,c1=pts.max(0)
   mask=tuple(tuple(int((lab[r,c]==k)) for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
   arr.append(dict(col=col,pts=pts,box=(int(r0),int(c0),int(r1),int(c1)),mask=mask,n=len(pts)))
 return sorted(arr,key=lambda d:(d['box'][0],d['box'][1]))
cs=comps(1)
[(x['col'],x['box'],x['n'],x['mask']) for x in cs]
